description: Structured interview scorecard — Structured interview scorecard for a role: job-related competencies with weights normalized offline to 100, what strong evidence looks like, behavioral questions with probes, 1-4 behavioral rating anchors, red flags, interviewer tips, a weighted decision rule (Strong hire >= 3.5, Hire >= 3.0 with no 1s) and a markdown table. Offline checks flag biased wording (culture fit, rockstar, native speaker, gendered pronouns, age proxies) with neutral replacements and any missing anchors. Params: role (required), competencies (e.g. System design:30, Coding:30, Communication:20), level, values. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_scorecard
